data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 魂灯夜话·「谢谢你……愿意来冥界看我」
data.description: 【冥界河畔·夜】幽蓝的魂灯顺流漂向远方，埃列什基伽勒与你并肩坐在河畔的黑曜石上。她抱着膝盖，声音轻轻的——「以前的我，只能等别人死后来这里。……现在会有一个人，特意活着跑来看我。这种事……比整个冥界都重哦。谢谢你。」
data.action: 抱膝坐岸边看魂灯漂流，轻声道谢红瞳湿润
data.camera: wide two-shot, two clothed companions seated on the riverbank
data.promptProse: Ereshkigal and a companion in a plain travelling coat sit side by side on the obsidian riverbank. She wraps both arms around her folded knees, her black dress draping over them, and speaks quietly while soul lanterns drift downstream. The companion remains a distinct, fully clothed person beside her, sharing the same calm view of the water. Blue lantern light reaches her blonde twintails and tear-bright red eyes, with the river fading into darkness beyond. Frame both seated figures and their separate postures in one horizontal view. No lettering.
